invariant_bindings.invariant_text: is_satisfied_by MUST be a pure predicate: no I/O, no mutation of the candidate, and NEVER time-dependent unless time is injected.
Composed specifications (and_, or_, not_) MUST preserve the identity laws of boolean algebra so refactors CANNOT change semantics.
A Specification CANNOT depend on the persistence layer; repository translation MUST be delegated to a separate visitor or translator registry.
The same Specification used for in-memory filtering and repository querying SHALL produce logically equivalent results.
Composition operators (and_, or_, not_) SHALL NOT be overridden by subclasses; only is_satisfied_by MAY be overridden.
